notes_for_editor: Three Black Peaks appear in these sources: this St. Joe site (6,258 ft, camp and patrol point in the 1930s); a Kootenai National Forest Black Peak (6,548 ft, cabin 1929, destroyed 1968; source 3); and a Sanders County, Montana Black Peak listed as Ground and Gone on firelookout.org's Montana list. The record's coordinates 47.18264, -115.27246 were not checked against any source page, so confirm the match before relying on them. Firelookout.com names St. Joe and Lolo National Forests; Idaho Fire Lookouts names only the St. Joe. The record's status 'gone' is not supported; sources say abandoned in the 1930s. No photo found.
